title: The model-per-role guard catches a spawn that names no model and inherits one above the role's cap
why: Incident, lane merge-runs-repo-checks, 2026-11-07 07:xx CST, relayed by the coordinator 08:25 CST: guard agent-role-model (the model-per-role check) let a test-author spawn run on Opus. The spawn named no model, so it inherited the session model. Rule roles-sonnet-is-the-ceiling caps the test-author at Sonnet.
note: The guard refuses the spawn, or sets the role's model, when a spawn names no model and the inherited model is above the role's cap. Done check: a red test on an unnamed test-author spawn from an Opus session. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). No owner question. Related debt in #1411: ready-checks-skipped-by-mcp.
